_meta.source: TSR 07514 - Gamma World, 4th Edition (1992 boxed set rulebook), pp. 193-194
_meta.purpose: Field layout only (labels/structure), reconstructed from the book's blank, reproducible character sheet template. No flavor text or narrative content - just the form structure, so generated characters can be formatted consistently.
_meta.usageNote: When presenting a generated character, fill these fields with the character's actual values. Omit fields with no data yet (e.g. Cryptic Alliance, Domars if not rolled) rather than leaving visible blanks, unless the user wants a printable blank-style sheet.

pageOneFields.baseStock: Base Animal/Plant Stock Abilities (free-text line - natural attacks/abilities from base stock)

attributeBlock.description: Seven primary attributes, each with Score and Modifier, laid out alongside the derived attributes they feed.

speedChart.description: Speed at different movement modes, each with a value.

pageOneFields.attributeModifiersTableReference: Same Attribute Modifiers Table as in gw4e_character_generation.json (attributeGeneration.attributeModifiersTable) - printed on the sheet itself for quick reference during play.

classSkillsBlock.description: Up to 5 class skill lines with point values, plus Domars and Experience Points trackers.
fields: Character Class Skills (up to 5, with point value each)

equipmentBlock.description: Up to 10 equipment lines for mundane gear.

artifactsBlock.description: Up to 10 artifact lines for Tech III+ items.

pageTwoFields.adventureNotes: Free-text notes area for ongoing campaign/session notes.

renderingGuidance.forChatOutput: Present as a compact Markdown table/block mirroring these sections in order: header/identity -> attributes+modifiers -> derived combat stats -> class skills+domars+XP -> physical mutations -> mental mutations. Omit page 2 (Equipment/Artifacts/Adventure Notes) unless the character has actual starting gear determined, or the user asks for the full two-page layout.
renderingGuidance.forFileOutput: If the user asks to save/export a character (e.g. as a Word doc or PDF), use this same field structure and both pages, leaving blank lines for fields not yet determined (e.g. Character Name if not chosen, Cryptic Alliance if none).
